title: Surface entropy budget of BR-Npw (northern Pantanal): code and derived tables
description: Python pipeline and derived tables for the surface entropy budget of the AmeriFlux site BR-Npw (northern Pantanal, Brazil) from the ONEFlux half-hourly product for 2015-2016, with the Planck (4/3) convention for the radiation terms, closure scenarios S0-S3, a daily block bootstrap and one-at-a-time sensitivity analysis. AmeriFlux input data are not included (CC-BY-4.0, https://doi.org/10.17190/AMF/1881563). Code is MIT-licensed; the derived tables in results/tables are CC-BY-4.0.
